g.text: Complete 2020 histories. Bar labels are household counts. Grey bar: never positive (excluded from the ascertainment denominator).

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Most reference-positive households are positive in only one to three of six windows, which is why sparse screening misses them.
